description: Use when managing Connected Apps for integration purposes — configuring OAuth policies, IP restrictions, refresh token expiry, pre-authorization assignment via profile or permission set, and monitoring connected app usage via EventLogFile. Also covers the running-integration operations: revoking a grant, rotating the consumer key or secret, pairing the app to an integration user's permission set, and the periodic review. Trigger keywords: 'revoke OAuth token', 'DeleteToken', 'OauthToken query returns nothing', 'ipRelaxation ENFORCE', 'permissionSetName', 'PermissionSetAssignment ExpirationDate', 'LoginHistory Application', 'connected app quarterly review', 'rotate consumer secret'. NOT for choosing which OAuth grant flow to implement — use integration/oauth-flows-and-connected-apps. NOT for decoding a specific OAuth error such as invalid_grant — use admin/connected-app-troubleshooting. NOT for authoring the full connectedApp / External Client App / Named Credential file or choosing the auth artefact — use admin/connected-apps-and-auth.
inputs: Connected app name and current OAuth policy configuration
Integration user profile and permission set assignments
IP ranges used by the integration system
Required refresh token expiry window for the integration
Named owner for each connected app in the org, for the periodic review
name: integration-admin-connected-apps
official_sources: Metadata API Developer Guide — `ConnectedAppOauthPolicy` (https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf) — `ipRelaxation` is Required and its four values (`ENFORCE` default, `BYPASS`, `BYPASS_2FACTOR`, `ENFORCE_RELAXREFRESH`); `refreshTokenPolicy` is Required, defaults to `infinite`, and takes `zero` / `specific_lifetime:n:UNIT` / `specific_inactivity:n:UNIT`; the statement that the refresh-token policy "is evaluated only during usage of the issued refresh token and doesn't affect a user's current session" (Core Concepts, metadata-examples § 1, Gotcha 5)

Metadata API Developer Guide — `ConnectedApp`, `ConnectedAppOauthConfig`, `ConnectedAppIpRange` — `isAdminApproved` semantics and its prerequisite relationship to `permissionSetName` / `profileName`; the empty-string deletion behaviour; `consumerKey` settable only at creation and uneditable after save; `consumerSecret` "isn't returned in Metadata API requests"; `ipRanges` `start` / `end` Required (Questions table, metadata-examples § 1 and § 6, Gotcha 10)

Metadata API Developer Guide — `ConnectedAppSessionPolicy` — `policyAction` `Block` "ends all current user sessions with the connected app and prevents all new sessions"; `RaiseSessionLevel` with `sessionLevel` `HIGH_ASSURANCE` applies only to flows with a user approval step and blocks API logins on flows without one (Core Concepts revocation table, metadata-examples § 1, Gotcha 5)

Metadata API Developer Guide — `ExtlClntAppGlobalOauthSettings` — `shouldRotateConsumerKey` and `shouldRotateConsumerSecret`, both defaulting to `false`, each requiring "the ignore warnings attribute in the deploy command" (metadata-examples § 6, Gotcha 10)

Metadata API Developer Guide — `ConnectedAppSettings` and `PermissionSet` / `PermissionSetApplicationVisibility` — `enableAdminApprovedAppsOnly` semantics and its "contact Salesforce Customer Support to enable API Access Control" prerequisite; the `PermissionSet` element shape used for the pre-authorization fragment (Questions table, metadata-examples § 1 and § 2)

Metadata API Developer Guide — `NetworkAccess.ipRanges` — "To add an IP range, deploy all existing IP ranges, including the one you want to add. Otherwise, the existing IP ranges are replaced with the ones you deploy" (Gotcha 8)

Object Reference — `OauthToken` (https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf) — supported calls limited to `describeSObjects()` and `query()`; the Customize Application visibility rule; the `UncommittedWork` restriction; the 500 / 2,500-row ceiling, the 2,000-row `OFFSET` cap and `NUMBER_OUTSIDE_VALID_RANGE`; `Id` "Reserved for future use. Currently, the value is always null"; `DeleteToken` and the `/services/oauth2/revoke?token=` URL (Core Concepts, metadata-examples § 4b and § 5, Gotchas 5 and 6)

Object Reference — `LoginHistory` — the closed list of twelve filterable fields (which excludes `Application`, `SourceIp` and `Status`); the `LoginType` picklist values `Application`, `Oauth, Remote Access Client` and `Oauth2, Remote Access 2.0`; the Manage Users / Monitor Login History access rule and the API 37.0+ own-records exception (metadata-examples § 4c, Gotcha 7)

Object Reference — `ConnectedApplication` — "all fields are read-only"; `OptionsAllowAdminApprovedUsersOnly`, `OptionsHasSessionLevelPolicy`, `RefreshTokenValidityPeriod` and the `OptionsRefreshTokenValidityMetric` duration-vs-inactivity flag (metadata-examples § 4a and Verify after deploy)

Object Reference — `SetupAuditTrail` — changes retained "for at least the last 180 days"; `query()` / `retrieve()` only; "`SELECT count() FROM SetupAuditTrail` works but `SELECT count(Id) FROM SetupAuditTrail` fails"; the `Action`, `Section`, `Display` and `DelegateUser` fields (metadata-examples § 4d, Gotcha 11)

Object Reference — `PermissionSetAssignment` and `User` — `ExpirationDate` semantics (API 52.0+); the View Setup and Configuration / Assign Permission Sets / Manage User access rule; `UserType` as "the category of user license" and its restricted value list (metadata-examples § 3, Gotcha 9)

Salesforce Developer Limits and Allocations Quick Reference — total inbound API request allocations per edition and per licence type (Developer Edition 15,000; Enterprise/Professional 100,000 + licences × per-licence calls + add-ons, with Salesforce and Salesforce Platform licences at 1,000 each; Unlimited/Performance at 5,000 each; Full Sandbox 5,000,000), and "Salesforce stores third-party access and refresh tokens of up to 10,000 characters in length" (capacity framing for an integration's connected app; token-length ceiling)
Manage OAuth Access Policies for a Connected App — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.connected_app_manage_oauth.htm&type=5
Connected App IP Relaxation and Continuous IP — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.connected_app_continuous_ip.htm&type=5

Salesforce Platform: Security Updates to the "Use Any API Client" Permission — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=005228838&language=en_US&type=1 — confirms the week-of-December-8-2025 restriction on self-authorizing uninstalled connected apps, the four-row permission behavior matrix it publishes for orgs with "For admin-approved users, limit API access to only allowlisted connected apps" enabled (the article does not address orgs where that preference is off), that existing active sessions are unaffected, and the September 2025 "Approve Uninstalled Connected Apps" replacement permission (verified 2026-08-13)
outputs: Connected app OAuth policy configuration (Permitted Users, IP Relaxation, Refresh Token)
Profile or permission set assignment for pre-authorized app access
EventLogFile query for connected app usage monitoring
Audit checklist for connected app security posture
Revocation and key/secret rotation runbook for a live integration
Quarterly connected-app review checklist (YAML the skill checker lints)
